source.paper: Wdowik, Varade, Vejpravova, Legut 2025, Magneto-Raman effect in van der Waals layered two-dimensional CrSBr antiferromagnet, arXiv:2503.15298 (preprint v1; journal version not verified)
source.figure: Fig. 5 (6L, 4 K, crossed +/-); peak description in Sec. III text and Table A3

notes: Same 6L flake as case 03 but at 4 K, below T_N. Circularly polarized, crossed +/- configuration, 532 nm, attoRAMAN in PPMS. Paper states two additional peaks appear below T_N next to Ag2 (~220 cm-1 shoulder) and Ag3 (~355 cm-1, assigned Bg3), only in 1L-6L and absent in bulk. Spectrum range starts at 151 cm-1 so Ag1 is not covered. Exported trace is baseline-subtracted by the authors (negative values present). Ag2 hardens at low T (peak ~247 cm-1 here).
